cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 runs a concurrent assertion action before its clocked NBA update (action_value=0 instead of 1), and fails an assertion whose disable iff becomes true in NBA (failed=1 instead of 0). IEEE 1800-2023 16.5/16.5.1/16.12/16.14.1 require the unsampled disable condition after NBA and actions in Reactive. Standalone Top and Wrapped reproduce both results; installed xezim agrees with the strict expectations for these cases. The sampled-history case similarly skips a newly enabled evaluation after NBA (passed=1 instead of 2); pinned xezim 0.11.4 gives passed=2, failed=1.
